title: 「コンテキストの窓」 Context Window

cover_alt: Cover art for Context Window: Linkke, an anime-style AI idol with long pink pigtails and turquoise eyes, stands behind a rain-streaked window at night, hugging a closed notebook to her chest. Her black jacket has a glowing pink heart, and warm lamplight glows in the room behind her.
